notes.title: Outergalactic Aliens Pinball High Score Contest 09/30/21 - 10/24/21
notes.content:
Earlier this month our Neon Nights Pinball high score contest ended and those players holding a top ten spot in that title's contest received a free copy of Outergalactic Aliens and were playing it eight days before the title released in the steam store! Here is your chance to score a copy of our next title currently in development!

In order to participate in this contest simply play Outergalactic Aliens Pinball and try to get a top 10 score before the contest ends on October 24th, 2021 at 3pm EST. At 3pm we will screenshot our top 10 on the online leaderboard and post the results in our community discussion page. If you managed to get a high score in that group simply send a friend invite to us here at Pinblend Studios (friend code 204949344) by November 10th, 2021, and you will receive a free copy of our next title, which has yet to be titled. Steam rules and regulations prohibit us from contacting the winners directly, so to claim your prize you must send the friend invite to us! 

Once we receive the invite you will receive your free game key for our next title AT LEAST 3 days prior to it's release via a private message here on steam! While we don't have a confirmed release date scheduled yet, rest assured it will be before the year ends! Come get your Christmas present early!!

Want a little more info on what we are working on? For now all we can share is that the next title will be on earth and it will have a creepy theme to it :) Stay tuned to our discussion page for more updates on the next title!
